content.title: Beloved Grey’s Anatomy character killed off in brutal twist as fans ‘sob’ over gut-wrenching scene
content.text: GREY’S Anatomy fans have been left reeling after a key character was killed off in Season 22, and they’re seeing similarities to another big loss. Fans were introduced to Katie, a couple’s therapist battling breast cancer played by Samantha Marie Ware, early on this season, and now they’re saying goodbye. Grey’s Anatomy fans said goodbye to beloved character Katie, played by Samantha Marie Ware, during a recent Season 22 episodeCredit: Disney During the episode, breast cancer patient Katie lay in bed with resident Lucas Adams dreaming about the future they could have had togetherCredit: Disney Katie was a patient of Miranda Bailey, played by Chandra Wilson, and resident Lucas Adams, played by Niko Terho, on Season 22 of Grey’s Anatomy. In Season 22 of Grey’s Anatomy, Katie participated in a clinical trial that helped shrink her tumors. Unfortunately, the corporation funding the experiment pulled their involvement, leaving Katie with fewer options for treatment. She was provided at-home hospice care at Lucas and Simone’s (Alexis Floyd) intern house. Read More Grey's Anatomy News During the most recent episode of Grey’s Anatomy, which aired on Thursday, Katie was shown in her final days. Lucas did his best to comfort her and “keep her lucid,” a promise he previously made to her. On the show, Lucas was seen laying next to Katie in her hospital bed as they chatted about what could have been. “What if we had more time?” Katie asked. Most read in TV “What if we met in college?” They dreamed up an imagined scenario in which they met in college and dated. As they chatted, Katie began to struggle to catch her breath. Lucas raced to gather medical supplies, but it was too late. Viewers were devastated by the loss, both for Lucas and because they’d grown fond of Katie during her recurring appearances on Grey’s Anatomy in Season 22. Many viewers noted, however, that this loss felt somewhat familiar, comparing it to Izzie (Katherine Heigl) and Denny Duquette (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) in Season 2. “I’m so sad they are pulling a Denny and Izzie AGAIN,” one viewer complained on X. “They have so much chemistry.” A second person posted on the platform, “Wrap it up right now I cannot do another Denny and Izzie situation.” “Lucas, please, you’re not Izzie [Stephens] and this girl isn’t Denny Duquette. That said, cut storyline but, as I was saying, already seen and already done,” a third bashed. A fourth posted, “They tried to reheat Izzie & Denny’s nachos and Grey’s without taking the time to truly get us invested in the relationship. I’m annoyed. It could have been great. It should have been great. The doctor/patient relationships are usually some of their best storylines.” “It’s Denny and Izzie all over again,” cried a fifth viewer. Katherine’s character, Dr. Izzie Stephens, fell in love with cardiothoracic patient Denny in the middle of her intern year. Denny was second in line for a heart transplant, but Izzie hatched a plan to bump him up on the list. She famously cut his L-VAD wire, making his heart less stable and the transplant more urgent. Denny did get a new heart, but Izzie was placed on leave from the hospital. He later died, leaving millions to Izzie, who was grappling with grief-induced visions of her former love. In an iconic scene, Izzie lay beside Denny in his hospial bed saying her final goodbye and sobbing. Grey’s Anatomy premiered in March 2005. The original cast included Ellen Pompeo, Chandra Wilson, Patrick Dempsey, Justin Chambers, Sandra Oh, and more. Kevin McKidd, Jesse Williams, Sara Ramirez, Eric Dane, Jessica Capshaw, Caterina Scorsone, and T.R. Knight are just some of the more notable additions to the show’s cast. The show has evolved in a major way since it’s early days, with many of the original cast members leaving.
